SBI Bank SO Online Form 2026 – Full Details

State Bank of India (SBI) has released the notification for the post of Specialist Officer (Vice President Wealth (SRM), Assistant Vice President Wealth (RM), Customer Relationship Executive). This recruitment has been issued for 996 posts. Online applying process for SBI Bank SO Recruitment 2026 has started from 02 December 2025 & the candidates can apply till 10 January 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SBI SCO Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 02 December 2025
  • Application Start Date : 02 December 2025
  • Last Date : 10 January 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 January 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Date Extend Notice
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is SBI Bank SO Online Form 2026?

SBI Bank SO Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
